reviews.text: Very good
Dr. Carlos and his team are very attentive and committed.
I've been taking my puppy here since his first vaccination, and he's been treated very well by the whole team.

We were very pleased with the service! We came to the veterinary center for the first consultation of our newly adopted kitten and were very well received by the veterinarian Daniela Leal. She was very attentive and professional, answered all our questions and gave all the necessary instructions, but was also gentle and managed to keep the cat very calm and comfortable during the procedures. We will return for the rest of the follow-up!

A big thank you to Dr. Inês, a veterinarian, for her professionalism, empathy, and care in treating my companion during surgery.
I thank the entire team, but Dr. Inês holds a special place in my heart as an excellent veterinarian.
Thank you very much.
Excellent service!
Excellent service and professionalism.
The service is incredible, the caring way they treat our pets is wonderful, the attention and affection they show.. 👍 …
Excellent!
My furry friend was very well received at your facilities. Thank you so much for all the care ☺️
Excellent team
Very careful and attentive service provided.
Excellent service, I recommend it 100%.
Top

Unfortunately, our experience was very negative. They took advantage of my cat's weakened state and decided to hospitalize him, even knowing that the animal no longer had any chance of recovery. Instead of being transparent and ethical about the prognosis, they chose to prolong the situation, which left me with the feeling that profit was prioritized over the animal's well-being.
At such a sensitive time, I expected honesty, empathy, and professionalism. I felt a lack of ethics and consideration, both for my cat's suffering and for ours as guardians.
I have another cat, but after this experience I will not use your services again.

We contacted the clinic with a question about the availability of a CT scan for a dog, spoke in English on the phone and conducted a quick survey of the situation. When we arrived at the clinic, they were already waiting for us and urgently sent the dog for examination. After the CT scan, the operation was shown and we were clearly explained how and what would happen, and answered a million of our questions.
The clinic staff and the attending physician called every day and talked about the health of our dog, during visits they were always open to questions.
At the most difficult moment for us, we found this clinic, and very kind and good people work here, they took care of our little one for a whole week after the operation and did everything possible to get him back on his feet.

I really like that this clinic has transparent walls and you can see everything that is happening inside. Everything is open and transparent. When we visited the dog, we were given a lot of time and space to be with the baby.

I would also like to note the care of the staff: our dog had 4 bowls with different food to choose from in the box. He was always carefully watched, his tummy massaged, played with and did everything he loves. In addition, each animal in the box is given a blanket - it is very caring.

Many thanks to Dr. Carlos, Dr. Daniele, nurse Adeline and all the nurses for their warm and kind attitude towards our beloved dog and us. Thank you for the health of our Lulu ❤️
Be careful. The veterinarians at this center don't know what they're doing; they're completely inexperienced.

This was my first visit to this private clinic. The service was normal. What revolts me is the business behind it. They already charge for consultations, but that's not enough; each medication application costs 50 cents, not including the medication itself. That's how the hen fills its crop. Apart from that, I have nothing to add.
My German Shepherd dogs were spayed here.

I am writing to file a complaint regarding the service provided at the Santo Ovídio Veterinary Center, located at Rua Soares dos Reis nº 501, 4400-316 Vila Nova de Gaia.

I would like to inform you that I had scheduled this appointment last week for the sterilization surgery of my cat, Maria Rosa.

On October 31, 2025, I arrived at the location at 9:10 AM, before the scheduled opening time of 9:30 AM, waiting for the center to open.

However, the establishment only opened at 9:50 AM. During the waiting period, I tried to contact them by phone using the numbers 227 117 564, 918 152 499, and 917 291 710, advertised as available 24 hours a day, but received no response.

This situation caused me significant disruption, both professionally and personally, as I rearranged my work schedule and faced heavy traffic to ensure my presence at the appointed time.

It should also be noted that I have a total of five cats, all cared for and followed by this clinic, which makes this situation even more disappointing given the trust I have placed in them over time.

I regret the lack of any apology from the staff present, which demonstrates a lack of respect and consideration for clients and their animals.

I request that this incident be properly investigated and that measures be taken to ensure adherence to schedules and improved service.

I went to an emergency room with my cat because she wasn't eating. After several exams and tests, she wasn't improving, and they said they had to do more tests and more exams. The price per night increased, and I was already paying a lot of money.
They kept doing more exams and treatments, even though they had previously told me that, if necessary, they would call beforehand to ask for permission. They did this once, and by then the bill had already accumulated to more than 500 euros.
I took the cat to another veterinarian, who told me that she had been exposed to an enormous amount of stress and that this could be contributing to her not improving.
The truth is that, after changing veterinarians, within 24 hours she was eating on her own again and stabilized.
I do not recommend them. I hope they change their policy of transporting animals from Gaia to Porto every night. Especially because of the stress this causes the animals. (If the clinic has 24-hour emergency care, it should have 24-hour surveillance.)

A very unpleasant experience, lack of professionalism, it seemed to me that both nurses and doctors were in the internship phase! It's regrettable how they take care of the animals! My cat was admitted to the emergency room on August 30th and I took her out of there on September 4th! She was getting worse every day...if I hadn't taken her out in a few days I think she would have died! I took her to her veterinarian and in less than 24 hours she started to react! She is already home and recovering very well!

I don't know how this clinic is still open...I can't understand what the objective is! I am very sorry and it hurts me to know that the animals that end up there, it's the beginning of their suffering! Watch your animals and observe them carefully each day that passes!
EXCELLENT PROFESSIONALS

The establishment was dirty on all three occasions I visited. From the entrance to the bathroom and the area where the animals are kept. Furthermore, they are an hour late for appointments, even with a scheduled consultation.
I don't recommend it at all.

The Santo Ovídeo Veterinary Center is, without a doubt, the best clinic I have ever been to. The dedication, rigor, and quality of care provided to my kittens has always been outstanding.
I would like to highlight, in particular, the excellence of Dr. Inês, whose clinical competence is accompanied by rare empathy and sensitivity. The way she communicates, clarifies, and cares inspires total confidence 🖤
I am deeply grateful for the professionalism with which you have cared for my kittens and I recommend your services without any hesitation.

A clinic of excellent quality, impeccably clean and equipped with all the necessary technical resources, allowing for the performance of analyses and procedures in a swift and efficient manner. I would particularly like to highlight the competence and high level of human connection of the professional team, who ensure rigorous and attentive care. A very special thank you to Dr. Joana Vasconcelos, whose professional demeanor, patience, and remarkable erudition made our visit extremely positive. An exemplary service that inspires complete confidence.

I would like to express my deep disappointment with this veterinary clinic, which demonstrated an extreme lack of sensitivity and professionalism at a time of great emotional fragility for our family.
We scheduled, on two occasions, the home euthanasia procedure for our elderly dog ​​(16 years old), who is in an advanced state of debility. Each of these decisions was extremely painful, made with much suffering and love, aiming to offer our companion a peaceful, dignified and painless departure in the comfort of his home.
Unfortunately, both appointments were canceled by the clinic at the last minute, even though they were aware of Tim's critical situation and the emotional impact that this type of postponement causes to the owners. This attitude reveals a regrettable lack of empathy and consideration for those going through such a delicate moment.
We expected more responsibility, more respect and, above all, more humanity.
This is not just about scheduling, it's about lives, deep bonds and very painful farewells.

I hope this criticism serves as a reflection and a catalyst for change, so that other families do not experience the same neglect.
The treatment was very expensive, but despite everything... they did what they could for my daughter's friend (her emotional support friend).

The facilities are well-presented, but the treatment of the animals 😭😭😭... Endless sadness, taking advantage of the fragility of the owners, "parents," to perform a series of procedures, saying they are necessary, which led to the death of my super robust puppy (he lost half his weight) in about 8 days.
I can't bear so much sadness...
Wolves in sheep's clothing, you'll most likely never see your "offspring" or companion again. I never did...

I have always trusted the health of my Chloé and my Thais to this Clinic for 8 years. But today, Christmas Day, what I feared happened. My Thais passed away at 10 am. So I called the clinic's emergency room to report what had happened and that I would take her there to arrange the transfer. To my surprise, they told me that today is Christmas and there was no one at the clinic, and that I should fend for myself. Soon after, they called me back saying that a veterinarian would be at the clinic around 7 pm today to treat the animals that are hospitalized there, and if I wanted, I could take Thais's body there, and I would have to pay as if it were a consultation.
I questioned why, since it was an emergency, they should do this, I would only receive the body and the next day have the cremation, which would obviously mean I would have to pay for the cremation services, and I also questioned why there were animals hospitalized there without the care of a professional, without receiving their medications.

It's regrettable and inhumane how I was treated, and especially with my Thais. Moral of the story..... so emergencies don't work during festive seasons....
I immediately called the Anicura Veterinary Hospital in Santa Marinha, I was very well received and they took all the necessary steps for Thais.
Here's a tip....what I don't want for my pets, I don't want for yours. Santo Ovídio Veterinary Center, never again, I don't recommend it.....the moment I needed them, they closed the door.
Note: I am very grateful for the services provided during these 8 years, but today showed me that they don't have that much dedication to pets and cats.
In memory of Thais.....who today became a star....12/25/2024
Testimony given by Thais's mom

My two girls have always been treated at this clinic and have always been very well cared for. Nothing against the veterinary team, on the contrary, only praise. However, today (Christmas) my Tatá passed away at home. When I called the clinic's emergency services, I was told that they would only be available today at 7 pm to go to the clinic and treat the animals that are there, and that I would be charged for a consultation and the cremation service. I was astonished by the response, as the clinic supposedly offers a 24-hour emergency service, and being a long-time client, I didn't expect this kind of response. It made me think that the clinic only cares about money, and because it's Christmas, the animals that are there and need care only receive treatment at 7 pm? It was a great disappointment with the clinic!

Terrible service! I admitted my dog ​​on October 5th; he was sick and hospitalized.
Four days later, he was still hospitalized, with no improvement! The clinic …
Parking is complicated.

They are terrible. The veterinarians don't listen to pet owners. My dog ​​can't take oral antibiotics because he has gastritis and colitis. I told this to the veterinarian, who assured me that it wouldn't happen with the prescribed …
